title: console-mvp-trim-consolidate-cost-breakdown-and-trace-cards
creator: Asha Patel
description: Reduce scope for Console observability MVP by consolidating the separate Cost Breakdown card into Route Cost Explorer and slimming the tracing surface to a single-span-preview with links to full traces (alpha). This ticket captures requirements changes, acceptance criteria for the reduced surface, decision rationale, and rollout constraints.
background: Original scope included: full Cost Breakdown card, multi-tenant trace search, span-level flamegraphs, and end-to-end route tracing on initial launch.
Telemetry and infra cost projections pushed projected storage/ingest beyond budget for Q4 MVP. Engineering capacity limited for trace indexing work this quarter.
Customers in pilot prioritized clear per-route cost and quick latency signals over deep trace exploration in alpha; sales requested lower-cost GA path.
This ticket formalizes the scope reduction and defines acceptance criteria for a trimmed-but-usable launch.
scope_included: Integrate a condensed Cost Breakdown summary into the Route Cost Explorer tile (percent-of-route, 3-point historical delta, top-3 cost contributors).
Expose a Trace Preview that surfaces a single highest-latency span with 1-click link to full trace viewer (full trace viewer behind alpha flag / separate product flow).
Add server-side sampling and storage caps for trace events at 5% sample rate by default; provide toggle for alpha customers.
Dashboard layout changes: collapse separate Cost Breakdown card into Route view and add a compact badge for traces; no new downstream pipelines.
Acceptance telemetry: per-route tokenized cost breakdown visible for routes with >1000 requests/day.
Rollout: feature flagged; 10% internal rollout then 25% pilot customers before full GA.
Minimal documentation updates and runbook for degraded-mode behavior.
QA smoke tests for data freshness (under 5m), tile render <1.5s for 95th percentile.
Coordination with backend for schema v2-limited (no high-cardinality tags in MVP).
scope_excluded: Full Cost Breakdown card with unlimited cardinality filters and query builder (deferred to Q1 roadmap).
Span-level flamegraphs, waterfall inspection, and long-term trace retention >30 days for MVP.
Trace-indexed search across all tenants; cross-route trace correlation is out of scope.
Console UX for deep trace editing and annotations.
Any changes requiring a new ingest pipeline or major infra storage expansion for Q4.
Support for on-prem Private deployments in this MVP cut (separate follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Route Cost Explorer shows consolidated cost summary for 95% of production routes with >1000 daily reqs; values reconcile with billing system within 5%.
Trace Preview returns top-span and latency histogram within 2s for 99th percentile requests under standard load profile.
End-to-end tile load time <1.5s (95th percentile) on the Console staging environment matching production-like data.
Sampling rate defaulted to 5% and enforced server-side; configuration flag present for pilot customers.
Feature flagged rollout completed: internal -> 10% customers -> 25% pilot -> GA gating checklist passed.
No increase in platform ingest cost beyond the Q4 budget delta agreed with Finance (<= +6% forecast).
Minimal docs and runbook published (Confluence link included) and SRE sign-off for degraded behaviour.
QA checklist green: data freshness, render performance, correct fallbacks when trace index unavailable.
Accessibility: new UI elements pass basic a11y checks and keyboard navigation.
Security review: no new data exfiltration surface; PII fields not indexed in MVP (manual verification).
decisions: Decision 2025-11-06: Consolidate cost breakdown into Route Cost Explorer to avoid an extra ingest pipeline (approved by PM, Eng, Design). See decision log: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/4312345/MVP+Consolidation+Decision
Decision 2025-11-10: Trim tracing to single-span preview with alpha link to full trace viewer; full tracing search deferred to Q1 2026 (approved by Eng Lead and SRE).
Decision 2025-11-12: Default server-side sampling at 5% to keep storage within forecast; pilot customers can opt into higher sampling with validation.
Decision 2025-11-14: Defer advanced cost attribution and model-level breakdown to Dedicated product track.
Decision 2025-11-16: Use UI badges and a single compact tile rather than new dashboard lanes to minimize layout complexity.
Rationale notes: keep initial value prop (quick cost/latency visibility) while deferring high-cost infra work.
